description: Hooks of this eca: aos functions run when an event happens. eca has before_queue, after_queue, brain_failed (CliFailed / ReplyMissing) and tool_added and on_clock in aos-eca-turn, after_start / after_stop and before_run / after_run (before / after each turn) from loop.json, and before_tool / after_tool only for aos tools called through aos-mcp; before_compact / after_compact come only from a claude body whose cli.json wires the template's compact_hook (Claude Code's PreCompact / PostCompact hooks), so this pi body never fires them; pi's own tools (read, bash, edit, write) and what a person types on the screen are not seen. The stack copy of this file overrides it by name, null turns one off. screen_linger_start cancels pending screen closures; screen_linger_stop closes screens after cli.json screen_close_after_s seconds (default 600, 0 immediately). Setting both to null leaves screens open indefinitely. The timer hook is a place to hang something every 5 minutes (on_clock, every_ms 300000, AOS_CLOCK); its handler does nothing. The mail_notify hook looks at your mailbox every minute (on_clock, every_ms 60000) and, only when new letters came, puts one message "[aos] new_mail: N new letters from A, B. ..." in your queue. There is no context_wrap entry: pi compacts by itself when the context fills up; to have aos warn first, add the context_wrap entry of templates/eca-claude with config {"percent": 35, "window": <the model's context window in tokens>} (pi's events carry no window).
